title: Silicon Stage — Cupertino Product Hero
description: A single-product feature slide engineered to Apple-site precision: centered semibold headline, one-line subhead, silhouetted hardware rising from a cool radial gradient floor — nothing else competes for attention.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment when the product is the entire argument. It borrows Cupertino's religion of subtraction — any element that isn't the device or its name is a distraction and has been excised. It is for speakers who trust silence and audiences who will lean forward when a single object fills the frame. It refuses bullets, decorative strokes, secondary brand colors, and every visual habit that whispers 'slideware' rather than 'stage'.
goodFor: One-line feature announcement with a flagship visual
avoidFor: Team org charts and multi-step process diagrams
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The mood is a cathedral hush before a reveal — one object, one name, silence doing the rest of the work. A cool radial gradient radiates outward from the floor beneath the product, creating the illusion of a spotlight stage rather than a flat background. Compositional rhythm is purely vertical and symmetrical: the eye travels down from apex of device through headline to subhead in a single unbroken axis. Avoid any texture, border, badge, or decorative accent; the only permitted drama is the contrast between the product's physical presence and the vast surrounding quiet.

examples.layoutNotes: Strict vertical axis: 12-col grid, all content locked to cols 4-9 (centered third). Product silhouette occupies the dominant upper two-thirds of the canvas, rising from a radial gradient pool anchored at the horizontal midpoint. Headline sits centered beneath the device with a single-line subhead directly below it, separated by tight but intentional spacing. No header band, no footer rule, no page number — absolute edge-to-edge negative space on all four sides.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a single keynote stage reveal — one feature, one truth, absolute silence around it. Composition is vertically asymmetric (text cluster floating in the upper third, product visual owning the lower half) yet perfectly mirrored across the horizontal center axis, producing a ceremonial, almost liturgical calm. Negative space is the dominant material; every empty zone is load-bearing. Avoid anything that reads as slideware: no divider strokes, no icon grids, no bullet scaffolding — only the object and its defining claim, lit as if it's the only thing that has ever mattered.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; all text content locked to cols 3–10, centered on the vertical axis. A small all-caps category label sits at the upper-third horizon line, followed by a single dominant feature claim two typographic steps larger, then a one-sentence elaboration constrained to roughly two-thirds of the slide width. A cropped product detail or solitary icon anchors the lower half, rising from the radial gradient floor which bleeds edge-to-edge. Slide number tucked bottom-center; no header band, no footer rule, no sidebar elements.
